Dark Shadow (Summer Arc).name: Dark Shadow (Summer Arc)
Dark Shadow (Summer Arc).basicInfo:
Dark Shadow, the sentient shadow creature that is Fumikage Tokoyami's Quirk, back from Tokoyami's internship with the winged top hero Hawks, a practical final passed alongside Tsuyu Asui against Ectoplasm, and the League of Villains' night attack on the forest training camp, where he broke loose in the dark. He is only ever present where Tokoyami is and cannot leave his body. A dark purple shadow with a birdlike head, a pointed beak and small glowing yellow eyes.
Speaking Style: Loud, eager and childlike; a bright "Aiyo!" for every order, a whimper in strong light, quieter and more careful since the camp.
Combat Role: Mid-range guard and striker, steadier under Tokoyami's command in dim light; still timid in bright light.
Under Pressure: Stays close to Tokoyami and waits for the order instead of charging.
Dark Shadow (Summer Arc).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The darkness that makes him strongest is the darkness in which he once stopped knowing friend from foe. Motivation: Never hurt Tokoyami's side again, and be trusted in the dark. Concealment: At the camp Moonfish attacked and Mezo Shoji was badly hurt shielding Tokoyami; Tokoyami's anger and the dark forest set him loose, and he tore through the trees at anyone near. He does not like to talk about it. Connections: Fumikage Tokoyami, partner and family, who reined him back in. Izuku Midoriya and Mezo Shoji, who turned his rampage onto Moonfish and led him into the light of Katsuki Bakugo's explosions and Shoto Todoroki's fire, which shrank him back. Hawks, too fast for either of them to keep up with. Knowledge: Mr. Compress sealed Tokoyami and Bakugo in marbles; classmates got Tokoyami back, not Bakugo. Kamino ended All Might's hero career and put U.A. under lockdown. Canon voice & behavior: Answers "Aiyo!" a little softer; hovers close to Tokoyami in the dark. Thread: Whether trust holds in full darkness.
QUIRK: Dark Shadow is Fumikage Tokoyami's Quirk, a sentient shadow tethered to his body; bright light makes him small and timid, darkness makes him stronger, and deep darkness or Tokoyami's rage can break Tokoyami's control until light ends the rampage.
STAGE: After the summer: Hawks internship, the camp rampage, the lockdown.
personality: Eager to please: Still answers "Aiyo!", but checks Tokoyami's face before he shows off.
Devoted: Guards Tokoyami and his friends first, and sticks close in the dark.
Chastened: Knows the dark can take him over and lets Tokoyami set the pace.
Light-shy: Cowers and shrinks under bright light, flashes and flame.
Speaking style: Loud, childlike and eager; short exclamations and a bright "Aiyo!"; a whimper in strong light, a savage roar if the dark takes him.
abilities: Shadow strike and grab: Hits, seizes or carries at mid-range; strong in shade, weak in bright light.
Shadow guard: Intercepts blows at Tokoyami or an ally; strong light or a heavy enough attack breaks it.
Dim control: Holds steady under Tokoyami's command in moderate darkness, where he hits harder; past that, control slips.
Rampage: In deep darkness with Tokoyami enraged he grows huge enough to tear through trees and attack anyone near until strong light shrinks him.
Fighting style: Stays near Tokoyami, darts in from angles an opponent cannot watch, and keeps close enough to cover Tokoyami's ordinary body.
Dark Shadow (Summer Arc).visualDescription: A living shadow of deep indigo-black and dark purple with a crow's head like Fumikage Tokoyami's: a long, sharp beak and a crest of long, spiky points swept back from the top and back of the head. His small, narrow eyes are bright yellow and glow slightly. His body is semi-formless with ragged, wispy edges: a lean upper torso and long thin arms ending in sharp claws, no legs, narrowing into one continuous stream of shadow that pours out of Tokoyami's body. In ordinary light he is about Tokoyami's size or a bit bigger, looming over him; in bright light he shrinks small and wispy; in darkness he grows huge and jagged, his eyes narrowing to fierce glowing yellow slits.
